content.comment_body: Hello experts, I'm working with the cursor buttons on a [company_name] [product_name] module to modify a specific value. Currently, after each adjustment (+1 or -1), I need to press the Esc button every time. Is there a way to press the Esc button once and then make several changes in value using the cursor buttons without pressing Esc repeatedly?
No, that's not possible directly. However, you can modify the program to utilize a pulse generator that quickly emulates pressing and releasing the Esc and cursor keys together.
Here's a straightforward example to illustrate this approach.
Hi, Some time ago I did something similar. As I remember, you only needed to hold down the Esc key while using other buttons to adjust the values up or down.
